scope: MNIST batch/width/learning-rate sweep only; user-authorized training

evaluation_protocol.metric: dataset-classifier polynomial MMD (KID-style, not Inception KID)
evaluation_protocol.estimator: full-sample unbiased U-statistic; no clipping or random subsets
evaluation_protocol.preprocessing: original grayscale [0,1]; no binarization or per-image normalization

summary.note: Minimum frozen classifier-feature KID-style MMD; not standard Inception KID. No test evaluation.

selection_rules.architecture: Lowest best KID among the four 60-epoch batch/width trials and the frozen existing 60-epoch reference. Initial 100-epoch prefixes are not extra selection candidates.
selection_rules.architecture_confirmation: Run architecture/batch winner for 100 epochs, reusing initial 100-epoch run when configuration matches.
selection_rules.learning_rate_base: Better of the baseline and architecture-confirmation 100-epoch runs; keep its architecture and batch fixed for all eight 60-epoch rate trials.
selection_rules.rate_confirmation: Compare eight rate trials with the matched 60-epoch baseline-rate control; if a new pair wins, run that pair for 100 epochs.
selection_rules.overall: Report best observed checkpoint and separate equal-budget comparisons; no test metrics are used.

decisions.note: Final learning-rate winner is provisional; last two 60-epoch trials and the conditional 100-epoch confirmation are deferred.

decisions.selection: Lowest validation KID among completed distinct 60-epoch configurations

stop_reason: User requested stopping after learning-rate trial 6; trial 7 had already started and was terminated. Do not launch further training.

resumptions.scope: Only final two 60-epoch rate trials; no 100-epoch training
resumptions.interrupted_run_policy: Preserve the partial trial; restart its configuration in a fresh directory
